points.description: States that the parameters K and x are constant (do not change with time) for the channel reach, depending only on the reach/channel characteristics (shape).
States that the storage–discharge relationship is linear (storage related linearly to weighted inflow and outflow, exponent m = 1), and that the method applies to channel routing.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only linearity/m = 1 or only channel-routing applicability is given.
